sloka: ततः शरसहस्रेण वालिपुत्रं महाबलः ।जघान मर्मदेशेषु मातङ्गमिव तोमरैः ।। ६.५४.१९ ।।।।
transliteration: tataḥ śarasahasreṇa vāliputraṁ mahābalaḥ ।jaghāna marmadeśeṣu mātaṅgamiva tomaraiḥ ।। 6.54.19 ।।।।

translations.english: Angada who was endowed with great strength all his limbs bathed in blood and terrific valour took hold of a huge tree and shattered Vajradamshtra.
